options_custom_url_help.message: Only use this if you are connecting to a self-hosted or custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Leave it empty for the normal OpenAI, Gemini, Claude or OpenRouter setups.

options_model_filter_placeholder.message: Filter models… e.g. luna, flash, haiku

options_reasoning_help.message: Only for models that support deeper thinking. Helps on harder sentences, but many models work better with it off.

options_reasoning_title.message: Enable deeper reasoning for compatible models

options_hide_native_subs_help.message: Hides the player’s own captions on screen (e.g. English on Prime). Keep English captions enabled in the player so the extension can still receive the timed-text source.

options_streaming_help.message: Show subtitles while they are still being generated. Turn it off if you want one full final translation at the end.

options_no_models.message: No models loaded — fix API keys or provider errors below

options_empty_catalog.message: API responded but returned 0 usable chat models

options_export_empty.message: No models are available to export.

options_export_done.message: Visible model list exported as JSON.

options_loading_all.message: Loading models for every configured provider…

options_none_failed.message: No provider returned models. Check the FAILED lines below (usually a bad or missing API key).

options_none_keys.message: No API keys configured. Add at least one provider key, then load again.

options_partial.message: Loaded $OK$ provider(s), but $FAILED$ failed. Only successful providers appear in the model list.

options_add_keys.message: Add provider API keys above, then click Load all models.

options_reset_done.message: All settings cleared and reset to defaults.

options_need_key.message: Enter API key for the selected provider

options_saved.message: Settings saved. Reload the Crunchyroll tab to apply.

options_err_not_found.message: models endpoint not found (bad URL or retired API)

options_err_network.message: network error — check connection or extension permissions

debug_playback_none.message: No playback event recorded yet. Play a video with subtitles on, then refresh.

debug_playback_hint_disabled.message: Target language is set to none — overlay is intentionally off.

debug_playback_hint_native.message: Official-only mode is not supported on Prime yet. Use AI fallback or force AI, with English captions enabled.

debug_playback_hint_parse.message: TTML/manifest was captured but cues could not be parsed. Check the raw snapshot sampleHead / error.

debug_playback_hint_waiting_player.message: Waiting for a real Prime player (not the collapsed ~50px detail-page video). Click play and wait for the full player.

debug_playback_hint_layout.message: Overlay is not on the video frame (wrong/page-tall container, or off-screen). Check containerH vs videoH and textTop vs videoTop.

debug_playback_hint_layout_ok.message: Overlay layout looks reasonable (full player shell, not top-left).

debug_playback_hint_active.message: A subtitle cue is active on the player. Pipeline looks healthy.

debug_playback_hint_between.message: No line at this exact moment — normal pause between dialogue cues. Not a sync failure.

debug_playback_hint_sync.message: Cues are loaded but the nearest cue is far from video time. Likely a timing/base mismatch.

debug_playback_hint_waiting_overlay.message: Cues are ready; waiting for the player/video element to attach the overlay.

debug_playback_hint_ok.message: Pipeline reached the player. If you still see no text, watch for sync_miss or check z-index / translation errors below.

debug_playback_hint_received.message: Subtitle source was captured. If this does not advance to cues_ready, parsing failed.

debug_playback_hint_generic.message: See the raw playback snapshot for details.

debug_hide_native_none.message: No hide-native snapshot yet. Open a player page, toggle the setting, wait a few seconds, then refresh.

debug_hide_native_hint_disabled.message: Hide original subtitles is off. Turn it on in the popup/options, keep site English captions enabled.

debug_hide_native_hint_ok.message: Native softsub layer looks fully suppressed (shell display:none, no DOM leak). On-screen extension text is ourOverlayTextSample (not playback.activeText). If you still see English in the picture itself — especially game UI / skill popups — that is burned into the video frames and cannot be hidden by CSS. After an extension update, hard-reload the watch page so hardSubs→clean stream rewrite can run.

debug_hide_native_hint_ok_hardsubs_rewri.message: Softsubs are suppressed, and hardSubs streams were repointed to the clean (no burned-in text) manifest. Reload the episode once after enabling hide so the player fetches the new stream. If English remains after reload, it is game UI burned into every encode.

debug_hide_native_hint_ok_hardsubs_no_cl.message: Softsubs are suppressed, but this title has no clean video stream (only hardsubs). English dialogue in the picture cannot be removed by CSS — only the extension overlay can show a translation on top.

debug_hide_native_hint_texttrack.message: A native HTML TextTrack is still in mode=showing. See mainWorld.videoTextTracks.

debug_hide_native_hint_waiting_canvas.message: DOM subtitle shell is hidden, but no ASS canvas draw was intercepted yet. Play while dialogue is on screen, then refresh — suppressedCanvasOps should rise if the hook is working.

debug_hide_native_hint_bare_leak.message: A child inside the CR subtitle shell is still visible (visibility:visible can override a hidden parent). See crBareShellLeak — display:none on the shell should stop this.

debug_hide_native_hint_api_ok.message: Bitmovin subtitle tracks were disabled via the player API (MAIN world). Native ASS should no longer paint.

debug_hide_native_hint_api_no_player.message: Hide is on, but no Bitmovin player instance was hooked yet. Wait for playback to start, or reload the watch page after enabling the extension.

debug_hide_native_hint_api_no_tracks.message: Player hooked, but subtitle track list is empty. Enable English captions in the CR player, then wait a moment.

debug_hide_native_hint_api_still.message: Player API disable ran, but at least one subtitle track is still enabled. See mainWorld.tracks in the raw snapshot.

debug_hide_native_hint_dom_api_pending.message: No light-DOM caption nodes (normal on modern CR). Waiting on Bitmovin API hide — see mainWorld in the raw snapshot.

debug_hide_native_hint_style_missing.message: Setting is on but the hide CSS was removed from the page — content script may not be running on this tab.

debug_hide_native_hint_known_visible.message: Hide is on, but a known caption target is still visible. See knownVisible in the raw snapshot (selector / id / canvas).

debug_hide_native_hint_leak.message: Hide is on and known selectors look hidden, but other lower-screen nodes still look like captions. See leakCandidates — that is the next selector to add.

debug_hide_native_hint_no_targets.message: Player found, but none of our known caption selectors matched. Native UI may have renamed nodes — use leakCandidates / canvases.

debug_hide_native_hint_waiting.message: Hide is on, waiting for a recognizable player shell. Start playback and wait a moment.

debug_hide_native_hint_generic.message: See the raw hide-native snapshot for details.

debug_copy_failed.message: Copy failed — use Download JSON instead.

debug_warning.message: This debug page must be opened from the extension UI. Open it from the popup or settings page to see runtime data.

debug_cause_none.message: No translated request has run yet. The extension is configured, but no runtime request has been sent.

debug_cause_url_mismatch.message: Provider and API URL do not match. The selected provider is $PROVIDER$, but the request is still using $URL$. This usually causes 401/403 auth errors.

debug_cause_bad_key.message: The API key is invalid for the selected provider or the wrong provider key is being used.

debug_cause_params.message: The chosen model rejects one of the request parameters. Try a different model or disable the unsupported parameter.

debug_cause_rate.message: The provider rejected the request because of rate limiting or temporary throttling.

debug_cause_json.message: The model responded with an unexpected format, so the subtitle JSON could not be parsed correctly.

debug_cause_ok.message: The request succeeded. If there is still a problem, it is likely a model or parsing mismatch rather than an API/auth failure.

debug_cause_unknown.message: The request failed, but the error does not clearly point to one root cause. Check the provider, model, and API URL together.
